text: Owner decided #5403 (workspace_sandbox confirmation gate): intentional as-is, no code change -- closed. Scoped #5409 into 3 slices after a full call-site survey (11 of 14 inspect_physical_path_containment() calls are check-only, ruling out simply merging check+read or always attaching a live handle to the result type): #5420 (new additive-only atomic primitive), #5421 (migrate workspace_agent_process_parser.cpp), #5422 (migrate workspace_agent_target_containment.cpp's one read call site). Opened PR #5423 for #5420: inspect_and_open_physically_contained_path() + read_physically_contained_file_snapshot_from_handle(), carrying the check-phase's verified openat()/CreateFileW descriptor/handle forward instead of reopening by path string. New move-only PhysicalPathContainmentHandle is PIMPL'd specifically to keep the public header free of platform-selection tokens (learned that lesson the hard way on PR #5418 earlier tonight). The new closed-window regression test caught a real bug before merge: the handle-based read's identity re-check reused the full PhysicalPathIdentity comparison including link_count, but the test's swap scenario legitimately unlinks the checked path (confirmed via standalone repro: st_nlink drops 1->0 on unlink even with the fd still open, content untouched) -- spuriously failing the exact scenario the fix exists to survive. Fixed with a content_identity_matches() comparison excluding link_count, used only by the new path; verified by reverting and confirming the test catches it. Windows CI (run 33423354845) and adversarial review both running now before merge. #5421/#5422 not started yet.
